create.name: Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Clermont-Ferrand
create.bio:
Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Clermont-Ferrand is a city-centre school at 19 rue Bardoux, close to the Jardin Lecoq and the city library. Christine de Bussy set it up in 2004 after returning to her home region; she had first opened a centre at Villefranche-sur-Saône in 1992. She studied with Faeq Biria, gained her first Iyengar teaching certificate in 1991, reached senior level in 2005 and has run teacher-training cycles since then. Within the French Iyengar association she has served as president, sat on its technical and ethics committees and organised its entry-level exams, and she travels regularly to the Ramamani Iyengar Memorial Yoga Institute in Pune to study.

The other teachers at the centre all trained with her and hold Iyengar certificates. Classes are split into beginner, intermediate and advanced levels and run on every weekday in a large, bright room equipped with props, and newcomers are invited to try a class before signing up. Alongside the weekly timetable, the centre holds three-hour weekend workshops each month, some for advanced students led by Christine de Bussy and some for students with at least six months' practice.
